---
title: "crash_analysis"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)

crashes_raw <- read_csv("data/motor_vehicle_collisions.csv")
```

```{r}
crashes_clean <- crashes_raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    # Date
    crash_date = mdy(crash_date),

    # Borough
    borough = str_to_title(str_squish(borough)),

    # Invalid coordinates
    latitude = if_else(latitude == 0, NA_real_, latitude),
    longitude = if_else(longitude == 0, NA_real_, longitude),

    # Contributing factor inconsistencies
    contributing_factor_vehicle_1 = case_when(
      contributing_factor_vehicle_1 == "Illnes" ~ "Illness",

      contributing_factor_vehicle_1 %in%
        c("Drugs (illegal)", "Drugs (Illegal)") ~
        "Drugs (Illegal)",

      contributing_factor_vehicle_1 %in%
        c("Cell Phone (hand-Held)", "Cell Phone (hand-held)") ~
        "Cell Phone (Hand-Held)",

      contributing_factor_vehicle_1 %in%
        c("1", "35", "36", "37", "52", "70", "80") ~
        NA_character_,

      TRUE ~ contributing_factor_vehicle_1
    )
  )
```

```{r}
crashes_clean <- crashes_clean |>
  mutate(
    vehicle_type_1 = case_when(
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "bike|bicycle|e-bike"
      ) ~ "Bicycle",

      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "motorcycle|motorbike|moped|scooter"
      ) ~ "Motorcycle / Scooter",

      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "truck|tractor|tanker|flat bed|flat rack|chassis|garbage|refuse"
      ) ~ "Truck",

      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "bus"
      ) ~ "Bus",

      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "taxi"
      ) ~ "Taxi",

      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "ambulance|fire|emergency"
      ) ~ "Emergency Vehicle",

      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "sedan|passenger|station wagon|suv"
      ) ~ "Passenger Vehicle",

      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(vehicle_type_code_1),
        "van"
      ) ~ "Van",

      is.na(vehicle_type_code_1) ~ NA_character_,

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Dimensions
dim(crashes_clean)

# Duplicate collision IDs
crashes_clean |>
  count(collision_id) |>
  filter(n > 1)

# Boroughs
crashes_clean |>
  count(borough, sort = TRUE)

# Cleaned vehicle types
crashes_clean |>
  count(vehicle_type_1, sort = TRUE)

# Contributing factors
crashes_clean |>
  count(contributing_factor_vehicle_1, sort = TRUE)
```
```{r}
write_rds(
  crashes_clean,
  "nyc_collisions_clean.rds"
)
```
